name: Medial approach to the 1st metatarsal
aliases: medial midaxial approach to the first metatarsal
corridor: Medial midaxial incision along the first metatarsal, retracting abductor hallucis plantarward, protecting the dorsomedial and plantar-medial cutaneous nerves, to expose the whole medial first metatarsal

positioning.text: Position supine with the foot externally rotated so the medial border is accessible, under tourniquet control.

surface_landmarks.text: Mark the medial aspect of the first metatarsal from the medial cuneiform to the first MTP joint.

incision.text: Incise over the medial aspect of the metatarsal shaft, starting at the medial cuneiform and extending distally to the first MTP joint.

superficial_interval.text: Protect the dorsomedial collateral (superficial peroneal) cutaneous nerve and the medial plantar hallucal nerve and the marginal veins.

deep_interval.text: Find the dorsal edge of the abductor hallucis and retract it plantarward, and free the distal tibialis anterior tendon to reach the first tarsometatarsal joint if needed.

layers.text: Skin, subcutaneous tissue with medial cutaneous nerves and veins, the abductor hallucis, and the medial first metatarsal.

structures_at_risk.text: The dorsomedial collateral cutaneous nerve and the medial plantar hallucal nerve are at risk, and the abductor hallucis insertion into the medial MTP capsule should be respected.

danger_zones.text: The dorsomedial and plantar-medial corners are the danger zones for the medial digital cutaneous nerves.

retraction_hazards.text: Retract abductor hallucis plantarward gently and keep the medial cutaneous nerves out of the retractor.

exposure.text: Exposes the entire length of the first metatarsal medially, though the lateral surface is hard to see.

limitations.text: The lateral aspect of the first metatarsal is difficult to visualize through this medial approach.

indications.text: Indicated to access the entire first metatarsal for fracture fixation or osteotomy.

closure.text: Perform subcuticular closure with resorbable sutures and close skin with nylon.

complications.text: Complications include medial cutaneous nerve injury with numbness or neuroma and MTP stiffness.

procedure_applications.condition: A first metatarsal osteotomy or fracture is exposed medially
A first metatarsal fracture is fixed through a medial approach
